name: Sumiyoshi Nana
source:
Shigure's childhood friend and the treasurer of gojoken. She is popular with the boys due to her "cute, tiny and child-like" appearance, but Nana herself hates being treated like a child, and yearns to be a fine adult. Contrary to her appearance and for the fact she refers to herself in third person, Nana is mature but also very blunt, especially towards [url=/c10395]Misaki[/url] whom she thinks is getting too close with Shigure. She is also bad at cooking.

[url=/c10397]Shizuku's[/url] best friend and classmate. Due to being childhood friends, Nana has known Shigure for a long time and often hangs out with him, but despite this, they seem more like a brother and sister having fun together rather than a couple.

[Translated from the [url=http://products.web-giga.com/hotchkiss/heroine.html]official website[/url]]
